none: PAS FASAM-2452B7: Roman Coin: Radiate of uncertain emperor
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a base-silver radiate, possibly of Philip I and dating to the period AD 244 to 249 (Reece period 12). FELIC(IT) TEMP reverse type depicting Felicitas standing left holding long caduceus and cornucopiae. Mint uncertain. This may be a contemporary copy or an overstrike as the obverse legend does not seem to make any sense
